messages:
Nina R: FYI we got a GCP marketplace intake request for the Redwood+Orion appliance. need marketplace security bundle: SOC2, redacted pen, questionnaire, firmware attestation. who owns artifact list/upload?
Luis M: I can coordinate partner comms. proposal: single bundle per listing + metadata file that lists regions and owners.
Sophie H: security: must include SOC2 Type II PDF, pen-test summary PDF (redacted), questionnaire xlsx, firmware attestation pdf, infra/network diagram png. redaction: remove customer IPs and keys.
Ben (Infra): recommend using presign-service for uploads. presign TTL 30d. Max PDF size 50MB; if >50MB use secure sftp manual ingest.
Owen (HW SI): Orion can produce firmware attestations but our reports sometimes exceed 80MB. we'll redraft and shrink; confirm sftp fallback process.
Legal Bot: confirm NDA 126-ORION is signed. partner can share sensitive scans. link: https://legal.redwood/ndas/126-orion.pdf
Luis M: owners: Luis (partner comms), Sophie (security signoff), Ben (ingest/ops), Owen (partner SI uploads). I'll draft runbook and share a doc.
Ben (Infra): short presign flow:
1) partner requests presign via POST /presign with metadata
2) presign-service returns PUT url + headers
3) partner uploads and responds 200
4) presign-service computes checksum & stores index
If checksum fails alert infra and partner.
Sophie H: pen scope must list Redwood connector + Orion appliance. redaction checklist: strip customer identifiers, remove live IPs, and mask UUIDs.
Luis M: timeline: need initial bundle by Mon EOD for GCP review Tue. Orion aiming for Monday if NDA confirmed (Legal done).
Deploy Bot: presign-service v2.4 deployed at 4123456786 1 infra-ci
Nina R: great. schedule a short sync Mon AM if any blockers. I'll post link to runbook when ready.
